dryEvidence: loam-hollow-rail, six rounds in fresh contexts, each told what earlier rounds found. Round 1: five confirmed (reach never walked with the home present; no inbox pool declared; provisioning asserted by names only; the no-fields case pinned a bypass without naming it; header cited two absent files). Round 2: two confirmed (a redeclaration the name set cannot see; no fixture below depth two). Round 3: one confirmed (grandchild declared after its parent, so a one-pass walk lists it). Round 4: one confirmed (create-path pool arm unpinned) and one plausible (root gate unobserved). Round 5: one plausible-low (pool differs from siblings in posture as well as edge). Round 6: nothing confirmed; one plausible alternative-proxy (a parented pool) and two cosmetic notes. Every finding folded; the final revision carries a fixture where the grandchild precedes its parent, a child precedes the home, two hand-made pools (one parented) are refused by their own sentence on both arms, a separate bystander binds, and the ground's delta count is asserted across a repeat create. Mechanical: four diff-scoped runs; final at 9e9d704: 14 mutants, 11 killed, 3 survived (the page's HTML template angle brackets, markup not logic); the runs earned five rails (fault wiring, parser empty-name fence, leaf length boundary, unsigned ground, leaf first-character class).

dryEvidence: loam-lens-name, five rounds in fresh contexts. Round 1: one confirmed (the page's name predicate narrower than the record's CONTROL — a C1 control character offered then refused as an unreadable record) and two plausible (select value trimmed before the reach lookup; usersHome fell back to the connectors' home). Round 2: two plausible (option doc overclaimed a refusal; a seed travelled as userKey). Round 3: two plausible (docs credited a seed with authorship; a pool inside reach drew the not-yours sentence). Round 4: one confirmed wording (inboxOf also marks a channel's pool). Round 5: three wording items (owner named one level off; new file's header named only §39 inboxes; colon count a floor). Every item folded as prescribed; the last round found nothing at the level of values: every seed is a seed, every author an author, one CONTROL predicate on page and record, one composite key joined on a separator neither half may contain.
